A journalist asks TDRA whether 'AI is running the network unsupervised' after reports of an outage in region R2. TDRA has received no notice from any operator so far. Internal question to the TDRA duty officer: under the operator's licence, within how many hours must the operator notify TDRA of an unplanned outage?
